privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This page explains how $ DOLLOR handles personal information. Replace this draft with your approved privacy policy.
privacy.body:
$ DOLLOR (“we”, “us”, “our”) respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal information you share with us. This Privacy Policy explains what data we collect when you visit our website or request an online cricket ID, betting ID or casino ID, how we use it, how we keep it secure, and the choices you have. By using our website or services, you agree to the practices described in this policy.

*1. Information We Collect*

a) Information you provide directly:

Name and contact details (WhatsApp number, email address)

Age or identity verification (KYC) details required to confirm you are 18+

Payment-related information such as UPI ID or bank account details used for deposits and withdrawals

Messages and queries you send us through WhatsApp, contact forms or email

b) Information collected automatically:

Device and browser type, IP address, and approximate location

Pages visited, time spent on site, and referral source

Cookies and similar technologies (see Section 7)

We do not knowingly collect information from anyone under the age of 18.

2. How We Use Your Information

We use your information to:

Create, verify and activate your cricket ID, betting ID or casino ID

Complete age and identity (KYC) verification as required

Process deposit and withdrawal requests through your chosen payment method

Provide 24/7 customer support and respond to your queries

Send service-related updates about your account, transactions or ID status

Share promotional offers, bonuses and updates (only where permitted; you can opt out anytime)

Detect and prevent fraud, duplicate accounts, underage use and prohibited conduct

Improve our website, services and user experience

Comply with applicable legal obligations

3. WhatsApp Communication

Our primary support and ID activation channel is WhatsApp. When you contact us on WhatsApp, your number and chat contents are processed to deliver the service you requested. WhatsApp’s own privacy policy (published by Meta) also applies to messages sent through their platform. We recommend messaging us only from your personal number and never sharing your login credentials in any chat.

4. How We Share Information

We do not sell or rent your personal information. We share data only in these limited situations:

Connected gaming platforms: Basic details necessary to create and activate your ID on the supported third-party platform you choose.

Payment processing: Information required by banks, UPI services or payment providers to complete your transactions.

Service providers: Trusted vendors who help operate our website (hosting, analytics), bound by confidentiality obligations.

Legal requirements: Where disclosure is required by law, court order or government authority, or to protect our rights and prevent fraud.

5. Data Security

We use encrypted systems and secure processes to protect your personal information and financial data. Access to user data is restricted to authorized team members only. While we take strong measures, no online transmission is 100% secure. Never share your password with anyone, and contact us immediately if you suspect unauthorized account access.

6. Data Retention

We retain your information only as long as needed to provide our services, meet verification and legal requirements, and resolve disputes. When data is no longer required, it is securely deleted or anonymized.

7. Cookies

Our website uses cookies and similar technologies to remember preferences, analyze traffic and improve performance. You can control or delete cookies through your browser settings; disabling cookies may affect some website features. We may use analytics tools (such as Google Analytics) that collect anonymized usage data.

8. Your Rights & Choices

You have the right to:

Access the personal information we hold about you

Correct inaccurate or outdated details

Delete your data, subject to legal and verification retention requirements

Opt out of promotional messages at any time by informing our WhatsApp support

Withdraw consent for processing where consent is the basis of that processing

To exercise any of these rights, contact our support team. We will respond within a reasonable timeframe after verifying your identity.

9. Third-Party Links & Platforms

Our website may reference or connect you to third-party gaming platforms. These platforms have their own privacy policies, and we are not responsible for their practices. Please review the privacy policy of any platform you access through your ID.

10. Children’s Privacy (18+ Only)

Our services are strictly for users aged 18 and above. We do not knowingly collect data from minors. If we learn that information has been collected from someone under 18, we will delete it and terminate the associated account immediately, subject to applicable legal retention requirements. If you believe a minor has provided us information, contact us right away.

11. Changes to This Policy

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. The “Last Updated” date shows the latest revision. Significant changes will be communicated on this page, and continued use of our services after updates constitutes acceptance.

Terms & Conditions – $ DOLLOR

Welcome to $ DOLLOR. These Terms & Conditions (“Terms”) govern your access to and use of the $ DOLLOR website and betting ID assistance services. By using our website, requesting an online cricket ID, casino ID or any betting ID, or contacting us through WhatsApp, you agree to be bound by these Terms. If you do not agree with any part of these Terms, please do not use our services.

1. About Our Service

$ DOLLOR operates as an online cricket ID provider that helps users connect with supported third-party cricket, sports and casino gaming platforms. We provide account assistance, ID activation guidance and customer support. $ DOLLOR does not itself operate betting exchanges or gaming platforms; features, odds, markets and availability are controlled by the connected platforms and may change at any time.

2. Eligibility (18+ Only)

Our services are strictly intended for users aged 18 years or above. By requesting a betting ID, you confirm that you are at least 18 years old, legally competent to enter into an agreement, and that online gaming participation is permitted under the laws applicable in your state or region. We may request identity or age verification (KYC) before activating any ID, and we reserve the right to refuse or cancel service where eligibility cannot be confirmed.

3. Account Registration & Security

Your cricket betting ID is personal and non-transferable. You are responsible for maintaining the confidentiality of your username and password and for all activity conducted through your account. Sharing login details with any third party is strictly prohibited and may result in suspension. Notify our WhatsApp support immediately if you suspect unauthorized access to your account.

4. Deposits, Withdrawals & Payments

Deposits and withdrawals are processed through supported methods such as UPI, Paytm, PhonePe, IMPS, net banking and bank transfer. Minimum limits, processing times and available methods vary by connected platform and must be confirmed with support before any transaction. You agree to use only payment accounts registered in your own name. $ DOLLOR is not responsible for delays caused by banks, payment gateways or third-party platforms.

5. Bonuses & Promotions

Welcome bonuses, referral bonuses and seasonal promotions are offered at our discretion and are subject to specific terms communicated at the time of the offer. Bonus abuse, duplicate accounts or fraudulent claims will lead to forfeiture of bonuses and possible account termination.

6. Prohibited Conduct

You agree not to:

Create multiple or fake accounts.

Use the service for money laundering or any unlawful activity.

Use bots, scripts or automated tools.

Manipulate markets or exploit technical errors.

Misrepresent your identity or age.

Violation of this section may result in immediate suspension, forfeiture of balances where permitted, and reporting to relevant authorities.

7. Responsible Gaming

Gambling involves financial risk and may become addictive. We strongly encourage all users to set personal deposit and betting limits, fix a budget before playing, never chase losses and never participate with money they cannot afford to lose. If you feel your gaming is becoming a problem, contact our support team to discuss limits or self-exclusion, and consider seeking professional help.

8. Disclaimers & Limitation of Liability

All services are provided on an “as is” and “as available” basis. $ DOLLOR makes no warranties regarding uninterrupted access, odds accuracy, winnings or outcomes on connected third-party platforms. To the maximum extent permitted by law, $ DOLLOR shall not be liable for any indirect, incidental or consequential losses, including loss of funds arising from your participation on third-party platforms, technical failures or actions of payment providers.

9. Intellectual Property

All content on this website including text, design, logos, graphics and layout is the property of $ DOLLOR and may not be copied, reproduced or republished without prior written permission.

10. Privacy

Your personal information is handled in accordance with our Privacy Policy. By using our services you consent to the collection and use of information as described there.

11. Suspension & Termination

We reserve the right to suspend or terminate any account, refuse service, or withhold ID activation at our sole discretion, particularly in cases of suspected fraud, underage use, prohibited conduct or legal restriction in your jurisdiction.

12. Changes to These Terms

$ DOLLOR may update these Terms at any time. The “Last Updated” date reflects the latest revision. Continued use of our services after changes constitutes acceptance of the revised Terms.

13. Governing Law & Disputes

These Terms are governed by applicable laws of India. You are solely responsible for ensuring that your participation complies with the laws of your state or region. Any disputes shall first be attempted to be resolved through our customer support.

support.title: Customer Support
support.intro: Need help? Contact the $ DOLLOR support team using the options below.
support.body:
At $ DOLLOR, responsive support is the foundation of everything we do. Whether you need help getting your online cricket ID, completing a deposit, tracking a withdrawal or recovering account access, our dedicated support team is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week, including match days, weekends and holidays.

How to Reach Us

WhatsApp Support (Fastest): Message us anytime on our official WhatsApp number. Most queries receive a first response within minutes. WhatsApp is our primary channel for ID activation, payments and account help.

What We Can Help You With

1. Cricket ID & Casino ID Activation

New to $ DOLLOR? Our team guides you through the complete registration process on WhatsApp, from sharing basic details to receiving your verified login — usually within 2 minutes. We also help with IPL betting IDs, sports betting IDs and online casino IDs.

2. Deposits & Payments

Get help choosing the right deposit method (UPI, Paytm, PhonePe, IMPS, net banking or bank transfer), confirming minimum limits, and resolving any pending or failed deposit with clear updates at every step.

3. Withdrawals

Track your withdrawal status in real time. Most UPI withdrawals complete in under 5 minutes; if anything takes longer, our team investigates immediately and keeps you informed until funds reach your account.

4. Login & Account Issues

Forgot your password? Locked out? Suspect unauthorized access? Contact us right away. We verify your identity and restore secure access quickly. Never share your login credentials with anyone, including people claiming to be our staff outside official channels.

5. Betting Markets & Platform Guidance

Not sure how pre-match, live or special cricket markets work? Our team explains available options, cash-out features and platform navigation so you can play with confidence.

6. Bonuses & Promotions

Confirm current welcome bonuses, referral offers and IPL season promotions, along with their exact terms — no small print surprises.

7. Responsible Gaming Requests

Want to set deposit limits, take a cooling-off break or request self-exclusion? Message our team anytime. Every responsible gaming request is handled confidentially and without judgment. Read our full Responsible Gaming Policy for available tools.

Our Support Promise

Fast first response: Most WhatsApp queries answered within minutes.

Clear updates: You’re never left guessing about a deposit, withdrawal or request status.

Complete confidentiality: Your details are protected as per our Privacy Policy.

Real humans: No endless bots; our trained team handles every conversation.

Hindi & English support: Talk to us in the language you’re comfortable with.

Tips for Faster Support

To help us resolve your query quickly, please share:

Your registered name and WhatsApp number

Your ID/username (never your password)

Transaction reference or screenshot for payment queries

A short description of the issue

Stay Safe: Official Channels Only

$ DOLLOR will never ask for your password, OTP or full card details. Only trust messages from our official WhatsApp number listed on this website. Report any suspicious contact claiming to be $ DOLLOR to our support team immediately.
